caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning
model_annotation: The plot illustrates Word Error Rate (WER) values for two different fine-tuning types during Whisper model fine-tuning. The x-axis is labeled “epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “WER” and has a linear scale ranging from 18 to 28, with tick labels at integer values. A dashed light grey line with triangle markers represents “tiny full,” beginning at approximately 27.5 at epoch 0 and declining to 24.5 at epoch 6. A dashed dark blue line with triangle markers represents “base full”, starting at approximately 21.5 at epoch 0 and declining to approximately 18.5 at epoch 6, with a peak occurring at epoch 1 with a value of approximately 22.
